ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 30% high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily in the distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white region forming a large wedge on the distal-lateral right lobe; smaller white patches on the proximal-medial and distal-lateral left lobe; dark pigmentation dominant in the central and peduncle-connected regions with various linear streaks of inverse intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 60-70 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits fine-grained irregular serrations with low-amplitude peaks; serration frequency increases moderately toward the lateral tips and the medial notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep from the medial notch upward to the distal tips, forming a crescent-like silhouette.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, dense clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; scattered circular white spots visible against dark pigmentation on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional linear disruptions (rake marks); prominent dark lines intersecting the white patch on the right lobe and white lines intersecting the dark mass of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified barnacle clusters at both fluke tips; significant rake mark scarring across both ventral lobes; small circular focal scar located mid-distal on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark circular puncture-like mark visible on the interior region of the left lobe; heavy splashing/water spray occluding portions of the lower fluke boundary.
